content.text:
I compiled the portfolio and the compiler rejected it, as expected, because of the explicitly requested unsupported readout.

**Compiled request (rejected as a whole):**

| Experiment | Method (registered) | Samples | Replicates |
|---|---|---|---|
| gfp_expression | genscript.cfxpress.gfp/demo-v2 | 1 (positive template + its NTC) | 1 per group |
| bca_protein | pierce.bca.microplate/v1 | 2 unknowns (+9 registered standards each) | 2 (duplicate) |
| picogreen_dna | quantit.picogreen.highrange/v2 | 3 unknowns (+4 registered standards each) | 1 (single well) |

- Timeline: release 09:00 Asia/Shanghai = 0 s; deadline 15:00 = 21600 s
- Budget: CNY 570
- Enabled instances: device:19, device:18, device:67, demo:ks4000:1, bench
- Demo assumptions explicitly accepted (costs, durations, digital carriers, layouts); cellfreeMIX, standards and working reagents prepared manually; manual transport permitted while liquid-workstation assembly stays automated; all registered assay conditions and controls retained

**Rejection:**
- `UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST` → "final read must be a Raman spectrum on iD5". Device:67 (SpectraMax iD5) exposes only registered fluorescence (EX 250–830 / EM 270–850 nm) and absorbance (230–1000 nm) read actions; Raman is neither a registered method nor a supported capability. I preserved this instruction rather than silently substituting the registered GFP fluorescence read, so no graph was produced.

To proceed, the final read would have to be the registered GFP fluorescence read on iD5 (EX 488 / EM 525 nm), or Raman would need to be dropped / pursued outside this registered method set. Let me know which, and I'll recompile.
